text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2024 or 2025. The latest supported tree-cover loss events occurred in 2023 (4.5 ha) and earlier years (2021: 81.3 ha; 2022: 0.6 ha). The data series ends in 2025, but no loss events are recorded for 2024 or 2025. Small patches of loss under 0.5 ha (not counted as events) were also absent in those years. The evidence confirms no significant tree-cover loss after 2023.
